title: HTSI September revenue surges 150% as AI chip testing demand accelerates
source_used: Digitimes (publisher preview only; the rest of the article is behind a subscription)
key_facts: Digitimes preview: Hermes Testing Solutions (HTSI) reported September revenue of NT$514 million (US$16.10 million).
That is up 2.35% from August and 150.33% from September 2025.
Digitimes attributes the rise to increased shipments of customized products, membrane probe cards and cleaning materials; the headline links it to AI chip testing demand.
quote_evidence: Hermes Testing Solutions (HTSI) reported September revenue of NT$514 million (US$16.10 million), up 2.35% month over month and 150.33% year over year, as shipments of customized products, membrane probe cards and cleaning materials increased...
why_it_matters_hint: More chip testing suggests more AI chips are being made, but one supplier's monthly sales is a small signal.
event_date: September 2026 revenue; Digitimes report 12 Oct 2026 07:27 UTC
notes: Digitimes is behind a subscription; only the headline and a one-sentence preview could be read, so fetched is false. No other outlet carries the figure (two Google News searches). The preview does not say where the company is based; the NT$ currency suggests Taiwan but this is not stated.
